Legend

Each mark is a shape and a line style as well as a colour, and its label is written beside it.

enforcedA plane decided the call and enforced its decision.
decided, not enforcedA plane decided the call and did not enforce the decision, or nothing read shows it did.
observedOnly a source reported the call, with the trust its source declared; no plane decided it.
exception or approvalAn exception the procedure states was taken on the call, or the approvals store granted it.
blockedThe policy denied the call, or the plane blocked it: a pause, a stop, an approval refused or expired.
not seenAn expected step with no call, or a source that was silent, never heard or not read.
